claims.qualification: Classify the actual vehicle, engaged feature, purpose and human role; do not infer from a brand label.

claims.claim: Pilot preparedness is $5,500; one 60-load replacement week adds $7,200; combined incremental stress cost $12,700 above common $324,000 freight.
claims.qualification: Rates, hours, loads and interruption are invented. $3,100 values existing staff time; $2,400 is an assumed paid backup-capacity reservation; $7,200 is the incremental paid replacement premium. $12,700 is economic burden above common freight, not all-cash spending. No frequency or quote inferred.
claims.recheck: Actual staffing, contract, service or replacement evidence

claims.claim: FMCSA grants a limited cab-mounted warning-beacon exemption effective October 7, 2026–October 7, 2031; other Level 4 carriers must give prior written notice.

claims.recheck: Current exemption, participating carrier evidence, cargo, configuration, domain or state intrastate treatment changes.
